title: iPhone free for 5 min while 2 jobs wait

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 5 min (since 22:41Z; released by fix-end-bg (process hold ended)). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: end-bg (owner fix-end-bg; waits on the phone); phone-queue (owner iphone-runner; its wait names the phone).
What unblocks it: the next of fix-end-bg, iphone-runner takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

This alarm is expected: you disconnected the iPhone on purpose (T-207), so nothing can use it now.
- The rows it named now wait on your reconnect; the end-morph agent's next step (a short iPhone check) also needs that reconnect.
- I'll post a "reconnect the iPhone" step when that check is ready; the alarm closes once a test takes the phone.
What you need to do: nothing; ignore this alarm while the iPhone is disconnected.
